JEE MAIN 2024 EXAMINATION
PHYSICS SECTION
Total Questions: 30
Total Marks: 100

Instructions:
Section A contains 20 Multiple Choice Questions (Q1 to Q20). Each question has 4 options (A, B, C, D).
Section B contains 10 Numerical Value Type Questions (Q21 to Q30). Candidates must attempt any 5 questions out of 10.
Marking Scheme: +4 marks for correct answer, -1 mark for incorrect answer.

SECTION A (MCQ)
1. A particle starts from origin at t = 0 with velocity 5.0 i m/s and moves in x-y plane under action of a force with constant acceleration (3.0 i + 2.0 j) m/s^2. At the instant x-coordinate of the particle is 84 m, the y-coordinate is:
(A) 36 m
(B) 24 m
(C) 18 m
(D) 42 m

2. A block of mass 10 kg is placed on a rough horizontal surface with coefficient of friction 0.4. A horizontal force of 30 N is applied on the block. The frictional force acting on the block is:
(A) 40 N
(B) 30 N
(C) 20 N
(D) 10 N

3. A body of mass 2 kg moving with velocity 4 m/s collides with another body of mass 3 kg at rest. If the collision is perfectly inelastic, the loss of kinetic energy during collision is:
(A) 9.6 J
(B) 4.8 J
(C) 14.4 J
(D) 7.2 J

4. Moment of inertia of a solid cylinder of mass M and radius R about its longitudinal axis is:
(A) M R^2
(B) 1/2 M R^2
(C) 2/5 M R^2
(D) 1/4 M R^2

5. The acceleration due to gravity at a height h above the surface of the earth is g/4. Then h in terms of radius of earth R is:
(A) R
(B) 2 R
(C) R/2
(D) 4 R

SECTION B (NUMERICAL)
21. A projectile is fired from horizontal ground with speed 20 m/s at angle 30 degrees with horizontal. The maximum height reached by the projectile is [ ] meters. (Take g = 10 m/s^2).

22. A capacitor of capacitance 10 micro-Farad is charged to 50 V. The electrostatic potential energy stored in the capacitor is [ ] milli-Joules.
